option.name: --cache
tip: Force caching on for all tasks and scripts.

option.name: --concurrency-limit
tip: Maximum number of tasks to run concurrently (default: 4).

option.name: --fail-if-no-match
tip: Exit with a non-zero status if a filter matches no packages.

option.name: --filter
tip: Match packages by name, directory, or glob pattern.

option.name: --ignore-depends-on
tip: Do not run dependencies specified in `dependsOn` fields.

option.name: --last-details
tip: Display the detailed summary of the last run.

option.name: --log
tip: Set output mode: interleaved (default), labeled, or grouped.

option.name: --no-cache
tip: Force caching off for all tasks and scripts.

option.name: --parallel
tip: Run tasks without dependency ordering; concurrency is unlimited unless `--concurrency-limit` is specified.

option.name: --recursive
tip: Select all packages in the workspace.

option.name: --transitive
tip: Select the current package and its transitive dependencies.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Show the full detailed summary after execution.
